In Rails, `force: true` will drop the table if it already exists before recreating it. While this migration normally runs only once (so a typical `db:migrate` on an already-migrated environment won’t re-execute it), modifying an old migration to include `force: true` does introduce a real data-loss risk in workflows where the migration is re-run (e.g., migrate:redo/rollback+reapply, or running migrations on a DB that already has `top_topics`).
